item.title: The Best International Schools in Baku
item.description: Baku is known for its striking architecture, seaside promenade, vibrant café culture and strong sense of safety, making it one of the region’s most family-friendly capitals. Often called the “Paris of the East” for its elegant European flair, the city blends Eastern warmth with a distinctly European atmosphere that appeals if your family is relocating from abroad. item.title: Family holidays in spring in the Holiday Region Interlaken
item.description: Spring in the Holiday Region Interlaken is all about fresh air, family adventures, and making the most of the longer days after winter. It’s the perfect season to step outside, explore together, and create memories. Whether you are planning a weekend getaway, looking for an active family outing, or organizing a school excursion, Interlaken offers experiences that combine fun, nature, and discovery.

item.title: The modern child's room: one space, many roles
item.description: A child’s bedroom is unlike any other room in the home. While most spaces have one clear purpose, sleeping, relaxing, dining, a child’s room is expected to do everything at once. Children today live in rooms that are simultaneously their classroom, playground, art studio, and bedroom, often all within a few square metres.
